rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record of the morning of 24 September 2008 says the cabinet meeting decided the resignation en masse (「内閣総辞職」について決定) and the 内閣総辞職に当たっての内閣総理大臣談話, and that at the resignation 福田総理 thanked each minister.

locator.section: 平成20年9月24日(水)午前 — ○閣議の概要について, paragraphs 1 and 3

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same record says the Chief Cabinet Secretary arranged that the ministers responsible for emergencies would stay in Tokyo and remain reachable until the attestation ceremony had ended (認証式が終わるまで都内に居て…), in case of a major incident.

locator.section: ○閣議の概要について, paragraph 4 (「緊急時の対応」)
